name: Klose K17 Pistol
summary: Dependable polymer-frame striker-fired semi-automatic pistol chambered in 9x19mm Parabellum, serving as the standard service sidearm across Leonida.
description: Inspired directly by the Glock 17, the Klose K17 is the ubiquitous workhorse sidearm of Vice City law enforcement and criminals alike. Boasting a standard 17-round magazine, lightweight polymer construction, and rapid cycling speeds, it is the primary concealable handgun used by Lucia and Jason in early robberies.

seo.title: Klose K17 Pistol: Specs, Fire Rate & Customization
seo.description: Full details on the Klose K17 Pistol in GTA VI. Glock-inspired polymer sidearm stats, magazine extensions, suppressors, and locations.
